opportunities.name: Cross-timezone meeting sync email
opportunities.description: For a city pair {city_a}/{city_b} and month {month}, look up the time difference on timeanddate.com, check public holidays in {city_b}'s country, then email ops a summary of the offset and the dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate.com and go to Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Search for {city_a} and select it from the suggestions
Search for {city_b} and select it from the suggestions
Note how many hours {city_b} is ahead of {city_a}
Go to Calendar > Holidays and observances, then open {country}'s holiday list
Note the holidays in {month}
Compose an email to {recipient}
Set Subject to 'Sync: {city_a} / {city_b}, {month}'
Set Body to '{city_b} is N hours ahead from {city_a}. Avoid: {holiday dates}.'
Send or discard the email

instances.values: New York / Berlin, Germany holidays, December, ops@example.com (Berlin +6h; avoid Dec 25, 26). An earlier San Francisco converter search at t=394–433 was abandoned.
London / Sydney, Australia holidays 2026, January, ops@example.com (Sydney +10h; avoid Jan 1, 26)

opportunities.name: Company account brief from SEC EDGAR + Wikipedia
opportunities.description: For a stock ticker {ticker}, find the company's latest 10-K on SEC EDGAR, get its HQ, employee count and CEO from Wikipedia, then email an account brief to {recipient}.
steps: Open the SEC EDGAR company search
Type {ticker} into the company/ticker search box and select the matching suggestion
Filter the filings by Form and open the latest 10-K annual report
Note the filing date
Search Wikipedia for {company_name} and open the company article
Note the HQ, number of employees and CEO
Compose an email to {recipient}
Set Subject to 'Account brief: {company_name} ({ticker})'
Set Body to '{company_name}: HQ {hq}, {employees} employees, CEO {ceo}. Latest 10-K filed {date}.'
Send or discard the email
